tips.text: Run a Steel Path Archwing survival on Uranus or Neptune with a resource drop chance booster and a loot frame for your 2 Tellurium.
Camp one spot in the survival instead of cycling; Tellurium drop rates improve the longer you stay.
Check Daily Tribute login rewards before farming; they hand out Tellurium and many players never farm it.
Farm the Tellurium while the Ankyros and Dual Cleavers build, then Forma and craft the Ripkas last.
Players call the Ripkas a cheap, boring build; Tellurium is the only chore.
